description: Pass/fail lint for ZPL: machine-readable diagnostics with line/column, code and severity (unknown commands, parameter range errors, layout overflow). Fast; run it before zpl_preview whenever you generate or edit ZPL. For a human-readable report with a score use explain_zpl instead. Pass the real label size — checks depend on it.
